subject: mathematics
concept: Real-world shapes, measurement, time, and money word problems using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore Model Method (bar modeling) principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student acts out a simple measuring, time, or shopping scenario with on-screen objects
exercise.pictorial: Student draws or labels a picture to represent a one-step shapes/measurement word problem
exercise.abstract: Student solves a one-step shapes, measurement, time, or money word problem and explains their reasoning

misconception_flags: cannot translate word problem language into the correct shape/measurement/time/money concept

interest_binding: word problems generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
